title: Two failures during an out-of-hours upgrade
problem: During an out-of-hours Jira upgrade for a customer, two problems hit at once. A departed colleague's MFA device blocked my sign-in, and an Azure guest-agent crash cut access for the whole organisation.
approach: I worked both issues with the customer's operations manager while the upgrade window was still open. I also warned the customer that the system would be slow while its caches warmed after the upgrade, before they asked.
result: Both problems were resolved the same night and the upgrade completed.
lesson: Tell the customer what to expect before they notice it, and check who holds the access you depend on before the window starts.
